description: 14 years ago, on Christmas Day Jun-young and Eunhyuk became siblings due to their parents' marriage. But both parents die in a car accident and the only person Jun-young could trust was Eunhyuk. Jun-young was a perfect protector and support in Eunhyuk's life. However, due to an event, Eunhyuk's attitude changes and with this incident, Jun-young decides to leave Eunhyuk's side as if she had fled and now because of destiny she meets Eunhyuk again at the hotel. Eunhyuk, seeing her brother Jun-young, walking hugs him, but unlike the warmth of his arms, he meets eyes that look at him in a very cold way ...
